title: SpaceX’s subsidiary Cursor tells lawmakers it's considering phasing out Chinese AI models
summary_full: SpaceX's Cursor is considering phasing out Chinese-developed open-weight AI models over geopolitical risk, according to a House report reviewed by CNBC.
summary_public: SpaceX's Cursor is considering phasing out Chinese-developed open-weight AI models over geopolitical risk, according to a House report reviewed by CNBC.
